title: George Kittle is eyeing SoFi Stadium’s grass—is that for turf stadiums or has he lost love for Levi’s?

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: George Kittle is eyeing SoFi Stadium’s grass—is that for turf stadiums or has he lost love for Levi’s?
sources.description: Kittle once called Levi's the nicest grass in the NFL. Now he's admiring SoFi's field. It might be regarding turf.
